Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "窗口明示接收者须具有 need-to-know。", "name": "need_to_know_required"}, {"meaning": "完整供应窗口没有陈述 need-to-know 条件；只判断该窗口。", "name": "need_to_know_not_stated_in_window"}], "examples": [], "name": "need_to_know_requirement_v1", "question": "判断供应披露窗口是否明示接收者必须具有 need-to-know；不得从必要目的或一般保密义务推断。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→need_to_know_required；“The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.”→need_to_know_not_stated_in_window。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_need_to_know_requirement_v1__15_21", "operation": "need_to_know_requirement_v1", "unit_ids": [15, 16, 18, 19, 21], "current_units": [{"id": 15, "text": "The Receiving Par-ty shall use the information only for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case."}, {"id": 16, "text": "3. Disclosure of information to employees The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case."}, {"id": 18, "text": "To the extent permitted by law, the Receiving Party shall ensure that said employees are bound to a duty of confidentiality for the term of their respective employment relationship in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement and that such duty of confidentiality shall survive the termination/expiration of the respective employment relationship."}, {"id": 19, "text": "4. Exceptions to the duty of confidentiality The duty of confidentiality shall not apply if and to the extent the Receiving Party can show that the relevant information was already in the public domain at the time it was disclosed by SINTEC; that it entered the public domain after SINTEC had disclosed it through no fault of the Receiving Party; or that after having been disclosed to the Receiving Party it was lawfully published by third parties without any restrictions regarding confidentiality or use."}, {"id": 21, "text": "The burden of proof for the application of any of the aforementioned exceptions shall lie with the Receiving Party to the extent it invokes them."}]}]}
